hero.title: Plan Your Next Experience
hero.description: Stay Connected to the events that matter most to you. Easily search and filter by type, location, or date. Shop Best Events to connect with a smooth, reliable experience for your business, hobbies, and event solutions effortlessly.

key_features.title: Key Features
key_features.slg_title: Olistami is a place of connection between those seeking and those creating authentic holistic experiences.
key_features.slg_text: It is not just a platform: it is a space where you can find direction and consciously choose what you truly need.
key_features.action_watch_text: Don't know where to start? You can follow the step-by-step guides:
key_features.action_operator_text: Do you work in the holistic world? Share your experiences on Olistami.

profile.title: Personal Profile
description: Create your profile and start building a space that truly represents you. Entering your data and preferences is not just a formality: it allows the platform to suggest events, practices, and experiences aligned with what you are currently looking for.
In addition, thanks to the integrated AI concierge, you can receive personalized suggestions and navigate more easily among available experiences, even when you are not exactly sure where to start.

You can update your information at any time, maintaining control over what you wish to share. Your profile thus becomes the starting point for exploring selected events, booking consciously, and easily rediscovering the experiences you have lived.

discovery.title: Event Discovery
description: Explore a curated selection of holistic experiences designed to support you, not just entertain you. From online workshops to in-person gatherings, each event is chosen to offer quality, depth, and alignment with the platform’s values.

Thanks to advanced filters, you can easily navigate between types of practices, locations, and price ranges. If you need a more intuitive guide, you can also rely on the AI concierge, which supports you in discovering experiences tailored to what you are looking for, step by step.
Whether you are looking for a moment of pause, personal growth, or connection, you can build a tailored path in a simple and guided way.

booking.title: Ticketing & Booking
booking.text: Buy and manage tickets and reservations
description: Booking an event is simple and transparent: follow a guided and secure process that takes you all the way to the final confirmation. Once the booking is completed, you will receive all the necessary information to enjoy the experience without worries.
Your tickets and receipts are always available in your account, so you can access them at any time and keep track of your journey. Every step is designed to offer you clarity and reliability.

rating.title: Reviews & Ratings
rating.text: View and leave reviews for events
description: After attending an event, you can share your experience through authentic reviews and ratings. Your contribution not only helps other users, but also helps maintain the high quality of the events available on the platform.
Reviews are a space of trust and shared responsibility: a simple way to give back what you have received and guide those who come after you in choosing the most suitable experiences.

payment.title: Payments & Invoices
description: Manage all your event-related payments in one place. You can view your booking history, access receipts, and check payment information in a clear and organized way.The platform is designed to ensure transparency at every stage: you always know what you are paying for and which experience it relates to. This allows you to focus on what really matters, without uncertainty or unnecessary steps.

subscription.title: Subscriptions
subscription.text: Create a subscription and access the benefits
description: Choose how to stay in touch with what truly matters to you. Through personalized notifications and updates, you can receive only relevant content without being overwhelmed by unnecessary information.Subscriptions allow you to follow specific topics, practices, or types of events, while the AI concierge can further refine suggestions over time, helping you discover new experiences aligned with your journey.In this way, the platform adapts to you, not the other way around.
